concept.zh: 最少跳数和并列路线数
concept.en: Fewest jumps and number of tied routes

brief.zh: 从 0 号跳板出发。站在 i 时可往前跳 1 到 reach[i] 格并落在板上。到达最后一块时返回 [最少跳数, 用这个跳数走到的不同路线数]。路线由落脚顺序区分。只有一块时返回 [0, 1]。空桥和到不了终点的桥都返回 [-1, 0]。
brief.en: Start on pad 0. From pad i you can jump forward from 1 through reach[i] spots and must land on a pad. Return [fewest jumps to the last pad, number of landing sequences achieving that minimum]. A single pad returns [0, 1]. An empty bridge or an unreachable finish returns [-1, 0].

snippets.code:
if len(reach) == 0:
        return [-1, 0]
    jumps = []
    paths = []
    for i in range(len(reach)):
        jumps.append(-1)
        paths.append(0)
    jumps[0] = 0
    paths[0] = 1
